title: Effective brand communications
slide_intent: Teach teams to establish the audience, objective and context before composing. A shared identity can give different local stories a recognizable form.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can preserve a common presentation across programs while allowing local content to carry the story.
demonstration: A red checklist precedes a black completion prompt. A row of similarly shaped glasses contains different colored fills, illustrating the relationship between shared form and local content.
practical_value: Before commissioning work, identify the objective, audience, context, feeling and channel, then select a local story that can fit the shared identity.
